description: A three-way sequential switch: one of three signals reaches the output, chosen by a shift input or by jumping straight to a stage

params.text: Jumps the switch to that stage by hand

inputs.text: A trigger above 2V jumps the switch straight to that stage
A trigger above 2V moves the switch on to the next stage, wrapping after the last one in use
The signal that reaches the output while that stage is selected

outputs.text: A trigger when the switch arrives at that stage
The signal from whichever stage is selected
